title: Chapter 295: The Second Zerg Air Force Detachment
content:
Chapter 295: The Second Zerg Air Force Detachment

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to his body, and he slept soundly for two hours in the Zerg mother nest, then woke up.

His mental power was fully restored, and he could possess others at will.

Wu Qing constantly possessed his clones and other Zergs, which consumed some mental power. After a long time, he needed to return to his body to rest and recover.

Wu Qing first paid attention to the battlefield between the Zerg and the aliens. The queen was commanding the Zerg army to fight the alien army according to his request, and he didn't need to intervene for the time being.

Wu Qing thought of the various information collected by the Zerg host about the Zerg's status as a major clan, and felt that the Zerg now only had some friendly relations with the two major clans, the Goblin Clan and the Naga Clan. If they wanted to obtain the status of a major clan, there would be many twists and turns.

To increase the success rate, the Zerg still had to rely on themselves and continue to enhance the influence of the Zerg.

The Zerg mother nest was upgraded to a six-star honeycomb form. In conventional combat, it was no longer afraid of any major clan.

If the Zerg mother nest wanted to continue to upgrade, it had to face the seven-star powerhouses of the evil god camp.

So the Zerg is now unscrupulous. They just want to keep taking the initiative to attack, beat the evil god camp, upgrade the level of the war, and let seven-star or above strong men join the war.

The six-star queen and six-star ultimate soldiers of the Zerg can cause damage to seven-star strong men. Among them, the Zerg queen and Zerg scorpion have the ability to kill seven-star strong men with one blow.

Strong men with stronger star strength will be dealt with by the queen herself.

The Zerg has finally developed to the point where it has the real confidence of a big tribe.

Wu Qing decided to start with the demon tribe.

The demon tribe is the second largest race in the evil god camp after the alien race. It is very powerful, but not enough to enter the ranks of super tribes. It is a very suitable target.

Of course, the most important reason is that the demon tribe has pushed the battlefield into the Zerg territory and is close to the Zerg.

Thanks to the early layout, the Zerg puppies hatched by the second Zerg sub-base are already in the demon tribe territory in large numbers.

The Zerg host is also in the demon tribe territory, constantly collecting various intelligence and drawing maps.

Taking the initiative to go to war with the demons, Zerg puppies alone will definitely not work, even if the three types of Zerg poisonous ray scorpions are added later, it is still far from enough.

In the second Zerg sub-base, the Zerg must build another powerful main combat army.

Now that the Zerg has the ultimate army, Wu Qing no longer considers building a ground main combat army, but to build a highly mobile air main combat army to quickly strike the demon army.

The Zerg wants to form an air main combat army, and the main force must be the Zerg dragons that consume less and are easy to use. Wu Qing first hatched 500,000 one-star Zerg dragons in the second Zerg sub-base.

These 500,000 one-star Zerg dragons are mainly used to deal with the ordinary demon army of the demons, and to assist the Zerg scorpions and Zerg devourers to kill the star-level troops of the demons infected by spores.

In the battlefields of the faction wars outside the public battlefield, the ordinary army still accounts for the majority of the troops, and the army composed of star-level arms are all elite troops of each race.

The armies that can enter the public battlefield are basically the elite troops of each race. Ordinary armies entering the public battlefield are simply wasting the transmission fee.

Therefore, when attacking the demon territory with a large number of ordinary troops, the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions are the real main force.

The construction speed of the second Zerg sub-base at the junction of the demon territory and the Endless Mountains is faster than that of the first Zerg sub-base under the 66th city. A large number of Zerg worker bees are digging at the foot of the Endless Mountains without hesitation.

The underground of the Endless Mountains is very rich in resources. The Zerg, which is protected by the system, does not care that the Endless Mountains are a taboo place, and just digs directly.

The Zerg has even dug out the mysterious underground world under the Endless Mountains. What is there to be afraid of?

With the support of a large number of Zerg mother nests in the second Zerg sub-base, the number of Zerg puppies entering the demon territory is no less than that of the Zerg puppies entering the 108th area of the public battlefield in the southern theater. It has exceeded tens of millions and reached the scale of hundreds of millions.

Such a large number of Zerg puppies invading the Demon Tribe's territory has caused chaos in the Demon Tribe's territory. The Demon Tribe is gathering elite troops to prepare to clear out the Zerg puppies in the territory.

The Zerg's new troops, the Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion, are also hatched at a certain ratio and enter the Demon Tribe's territory to assist the Zerg puppies in combat.

With the long-range attack support of the Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion, the Zerg puppies can attack more Demon Tribe targets.

The purpose of the Zerg forming the main air combat force is to eliminate the assembled elite troops of the Demon Tribe.

A small number of Demon Tribe star-level troops, Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion, can be eliminated without suffering any loss.

If it is a large-scale Demon Tribe star-level troops, Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion will suffer some losses in dealing with it.

The Demon Tribe army outside the forbidden land has not only the three types of inferior demons, flame demons and dog demons, but also many more strange troops.

The demons and Zerg are somewhat similar, both are physically evolved races, which results in their appearance and abilities being all kinds of strange, and the demon army has a very rich variety of arms.

With so many arms, the elite demon army, when the strength reaches a certain scale, the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions will choose to avoid fighting.

With the real-time intelligence provided by the Zerg host, it is very easy for the Zerg with the ability to burrow to avoid fighting.

……

After hatching 500,000 one-star Zerg dragons, Wu Qing hatched another 20,000 Zerg dragons, and evolved and upgraded the 20,000 Zerg dragons into 10,000 five-star Zerg air guards and 10,000 five-star Zerg devourers.

These 20,000 five-star Zerg ultimate arms are the core of this Zerg air force.

With the existence of these Zerg ultimate arms, the Zerg air force can quickly deal with the elite troops of the demon star arms of the millions.

Even if it faces the elite troops of the demon star arms of the tens of millions, the Zerg air force is enough to deal with it.

The Zerg air force is not fighting alone. For major combat missions, there will be a large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions on the ground.

In order to enable this Zerg air force to cope with more complex battlefield environments, Wu Qing also appropriately configured high-star strength auxiliary arms for them.

Ten six-star Zerg Queens, ten six-star Zerg Scorpions, and ten six-star Zerg Mammoths were hatched, and a small team of five-star Zerg transport hosts flew over and loaded the ten six-star Zerg Scorpions and ten six-star Zerg Mammoths.

With these high-star Zerg auxiliary arms, even if a seven-star demon clan powerhouse appears, the Zerg air force has the means to deal with it.

A Zerg air force of more than 500,000 troops was built. This is a customized force with high and low matching. Five hundred thousand one-star Zerg flying dragons are matched with a group of five-star and six-star Zerg ultimate arms.

This is an efficient and resource-saving matching method, which consumes a lot of resources on important arms.

…

After the second detachment of the Zerg air force was built, it could not waste combat power. Wu Qing immediately gave them combat orders.

On Wu Qing's self-made system map, a very detailed combat map has been drawn for the demon clan territory area adjacent to the Zerg territory.

The gathering points of the elite troops of the demon tribe's star-level soldiers in the demon tribe's territory were marked on the battle map one by one.

Led by the five-star Zerg Devourer, the second detachment of the Zerg air force quickly flew to the demon tribe army gathering point closest to the second Zerg sub-base marked on the battle map.

The Zerg air force flew very fast and arrived near the target location not long after.

The target was a huge demon castle, where millions of elite demon tribe star-level troops were stationed. They were the troops responsible for the task of clearing the Zerg puppies in this area.

In addition to various ground demon tribe troops, these demon tribe troops also had some flying big demons and winged demons.

Big demons were at least five-star troops, and they were the real strong tribes in the demon tribe, and there were not many of them.

Those numerous winged demons were the main force of the demon tribe's air force.

No matter what kind of troops the demon army is composed of, the Zerg has beaten the super tribe of the alien race in conventional combat, so there is no need to think too much about returning to fight the demons.

Wu Qing did not go into the characteristics of the various troops of the demons. They were no different under the attack of the five-star Zerg air guards and the five-star Zerg Devourers.

From a distance, the five-star Zerg air guards with beyond-visual-range attack range launched a round of attacks on the demon castle.

Under the powerful coverage attack of 10,000 five-star Zerg air guards, the demon castle collapsed and was damaged on a large scale, and a large number of demon troops were killed and wounded.

The weird self-esteem of the demons began to work again. The demon army under attack did not think about hiding in the castle, but rushed out of the castle.

Those big demons and winged demons flew out of the castle first. Those demon troops fighting on the ground did not think about how to defend and fight, but how to get out of the city quickly.

The attack speed of 10,000 five-star Zerg air guards was very fast. The second and third rounds of attacks followed closely, and soon the Demon Citadel was destroyed beyond recognition.

The Demon Citadel's big demons and winged demons flew into the sky, discovered the Zerg air force, and immediately flew over, fearlessly attacking the Zerg air force.

The Demon Citadel's air force also had a strength of about 300,000, which did not seem to be very different from the Zerg air force. In addition, they had a large number of ground troops as a backup, so they were not timid at all.
